request: a status card: CPU 73%, memory 41%, disk 58%, a small bar for each
program:
# A rounded card titled "System" holding one labelled bar per line.
screen = canvas.screen
inner = screen.width - 2


def gauge(label, percent):
    cells = inner - len(label) - 6
    filled = round(cells * percent / 100)
    bar = "█" * filled + "░" * (cells - filled)
    return f"{label} {bar} {percent:>3}%"


lines = [gauge("CPU ", 73), gauge("MEM ", 41), gauge("DISK", 58)]
screen.write(lines, border="rounded", title="System", foreground="cyan")

request: a two-column table of names and points, values right-aligned
program:
# A bold header row, a rule, then one flowing row per entry: name left, points right.
screen = canvas.screen
rows = [("Alice", "1,204"), ("Bob", "987"), ("Carol", "865"), ("Dave", "742")]
name_width = max(len(name) for name, _ in rows)
value_width = screen.width - name_width - 2
screen.write(f"{'Name':<{name_width}}  {'Points':>{value_width}}", bold=True)
screen.write("─" * screen.width, dim=True)
for name, points in rows:
    screen.write(f"{name:<{name_width}}  {points:>{value_width}}")

request: a main menu with four items where the second one is highlighted
program:
# A centred title on the first row, then one menu line per item from row 2; the selected item is inverted.
screen = canvas.screen
items = ["New game", "Continue", "Options", "Quit"]
selected = 1
screen.write("MAIN MENU", x="center", y=0, bold=True)
for index in range(len(items)):
    is_selected = index == selected
    pointer = "▶" if is_selected else " "
    line = f" {pointer} {items[index]:<{screen.width - 4}}"
    if is_selected:
        screen.write(line, y=2 + index, foreground="black", background="yellow", bold=True)
    else:
        screen.write(line, y=2 + index)

request: a to-do list with checkboxes, finished tasks greyed out
program:
# A bold heading with the done count, then one flowing line per task: a checkbox and the task text.
screen = canvas.screen
tasks = [
    ("Write the report", True),
    ("Review pull request", True),
    ("Book the venue", False),
    ("Call the supplier", False),
    ("Plan the sprint", False),
]
done_count = 0
for _, is_done in tasks:
    if is_done:
        done_count += 1
screen.write(f"To do  {done_count}/{len(tasks)} done", bold=True)
for task, is_done in tasks:
    marker = "[x]" if is_done else "[ ]"
    screen.write(f"{marker} {task}", dim=is_done)

request: a sparkline of requests per minute with min and max underneath
program:
# A bold title, a sparkline whose block height follows each value, then a dim footer with min, max and last.
screen = canvas.screen
values = [3, 5, 8, 6, 9, 12, 10, 7, 11, 14, 13, 9, 6, 8, 12, 15, 11, 7, 5, 4, 6, 9, 13, 10]
blocks = "▁▂▃▄▅▆▇█"
low = min(values)
high = max(values)
spark = ""
for value in values:
    level = round((value - low) / (high - low) * (len(blocks) - 1))
    spark += blocks[level]
screen.write("Requests per minute", bold=True)
screen.write(spark, foreground="cyan")
screen.write(f"min {low}  max {high}  last {values[-1]}", dim=True)

request: a file list with sizes, directories in blue
